editorial:
Ever felt so heartbroken that you just couldn't let go? You will totally relate to the main character here, a stressed-out girl who is desperate for answers after her breakup. Instead of just moving on, she comes up with a wild plan to hire a friend to pretend to be someone else on a dating app. The goal is to trick her ex-boyfriend into falling for this fake person to see if he is still the same guy she loved. It feels like a messy, modern comedy of errors where everything that can go wrong probably will, making the whole vibe feel like a chaotic night out with your most dramatic friends.

The acting is really natural and makes the awkward moments feel real. You will love how the tension builds as the lies get bigger and harder to manage. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy stories about bad decisions and dating disasters, you should definitely give this one a try.
endingExplained: In the end, the plan totally backfires. The ex-boyfriend finds out he is being tricked, which leads to a huge, honest confrontation between the two former lovers. Instead of getting the perfect closure she wanted through a lie, the main character realizes that her obsession was actually stopping her from healing. She finally stops the games, apologizes for the catfish stunt, and decides to move on with her life for real.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a dark twist and stories about modern dating.
